name: Ackerstein Group Ltd
summary: Ackerstein Group Ltd produces, markets, and sells concrete products in Israel and internationally. It offers concrete products for environmental development and landscape design services, including interlocking stones in various finish levels and colors, paving and cladding tiles, and garden and curb stones; mechanized infrastructure products, such as pipes of various diameters, round and rectangular control chambers, receivers, segments, and retaining walls; and construction products comprising concrete roof tiles and cladding.
